in_hebrew.name: Fairleigh
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fairleigh הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English words 'fæger' meaning 'fair' and 'lēah' meaning 'meadow'. The name Fairleigh was popular in England during the Middle Ages.

in_latin.name: Fairleigh
in_latin.meaning: Fair, light, and noble, derived from Old English words
in_latin.long_meaning: Fairleigh, a name of English origin, is derived from the Old English words 'fæir' meaning fair or light, and 'hlæh' meaning noble. In the context of Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the qualities of purity, innocence, and nobility, reflecting the virtues of the Christian faith.
